basic_details.job_title: KSSSCI Medical Physics Resident Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: Kalyan Singh Super Specialty Cancer Institute (Kalyan Singh Ati Vishisht Cancer Sansthan), Lucknow, an autonomous institute of the Government of Uttar Pradesh, will hold a walk-in interview for 1 post of Medical Physics Resident at the Admin. Block at KSSSCI, Lucknow (C.G. City, Sultanpur Road, Lucknow-226002). The reporting time is 09:30 AM and the interview starts at 11:00 AM. The post is a short-term recruitment for 12 months with an initial pay of Rs. 35,400 in Pay Matrix Level-6 (Rs. 35,400-1,12,400). The upper age limit is 45 years as on the date of interview, and the fee is Rs. 500.

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: Kalyan Singh Super Specialty Cancer Institute (KSSSCI) is located at C.G. City, Sultanpur Road, Lucknow-226002, and is an autonomous institute of the Government of Uttar Pradesh. This recruitment notice was issued by the Executive Registrar Office of KSSSCI, which can be contacted at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: KSSSCI has advertised one vacant post of Medical Physics Resident for short-term recruitment. The notice says that the positions of Residents listed are indicative only and can increase or decrease at the time of interview without notice. The notice prints the following qualification for the Medical Physics Resident post: M.Sc. in Medical Physics/M.Sc. in Physics from a recognized University followed by postgraduate Diploma in Radiological Physics from BARC, Mumbai or equivalent qualification recommended to AERB, Mumbai. The notice also states that the candidate should be registered with Medical Council / Dental Council of U.P. It adds that the prescribed qualification is the minimum requirement and merely possessing it does not entitle a candidate to selection. For the exact eligibility wording, candidates should refer to the official notification. The upper age limit for the Medical Physics Resident post is 45 years as on the date of interview. The benefit of reservation and age relaxation will be given only to candidates who have the domicile of Uttar Pradesh. Pay and allowances will be as per the 7th Pay Commission, as per State Government / institute rules. The notice does not list the individual allowances. No travelling or other allowances will be paid to the candidate for joining the post.

rows.relaxation: As per UP Government rules/DoPT rules

rows.pay_level_pay: Initial pay Rs. 35,400 in the pay matrix Rs. 35,400-1,12,400/- Level-6

content_sections.heading: Application Form and Fee
content_sections.text: There is no online application. Candidates fill in the application form attached to the notice and bring it to the walk-in interview. The notice gives these steps: Fill in the attached application form legibly. The form asks for the post applied for, personal details, Aadhaar and PAN numbers, addresses, category, state of domicile, council registration, academic qualifications, employment details, bank account details and Hepatitis B immunization status. A self-signed passport size photograph is pasted on the form. Pay the non-refundable fee of Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only) by RTGS/NEFT to Account No. 37868945001, Name of Account: 'Director, SSCI&H, Academic Account', State Bank of India, SGPGIMS, Raebareli Road, Lucknow, IFSC Code: SBIN0007789. Write the payment amount and date on the application form and enclose the payment receipt. Attach Xerox copies of all relevant certificates and testimonials to the application form. If currently employed, get the application forwarded by the head of the institution (competent authority) through the section on the form, or attach a No Objection Certificate. Bring the filled form with its annexures, original documents and photographs to the venue by the reporting time.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The filled application form as prescribed, with the annexures Receipt of the RTGS/NEFT payment of Rs. 500 Self-attested photocopies of all relevant certificates and testimonials Original copies of all relevant certificates and testimonials for verification Three recent passport size photographs A No Objection Certificate from the competent authority of the present organisation, if employed in another organisation Candidates who do not produce the original documents at the time of interview will not be considered for selection.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates report at the Admin. Block at KSSSCI, Lucknow at 09:30 AM. The walk-in interview starts at 11:00 AM, and no candidate will be allowed to appear for the interview if he or she reports after 11:00 AM on the day of interview. Original documents are checked for verification at the interview. The results will be declared on the institute website, and the institute will send the appointment letter to selected candidates by e-mail. The decision of the competent authority regarding selection is final, no representations will be entertained, and the decision of the committee is final and binding.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Appointment
content_sections.text: The appointment is for a tenure of 12 months, and the contract automatically expires on completion of 12 months. The appointment gives no right to claim regular appointment, permanent absorption or continued contractual appointment; the contract may be renewed or terminated as decided by the institute, and renewal is at the absolute discretion of Director, KSSSCI. The institute can terminate the contractual appointment at any time without a notice period. The employee can leave by giving 30 days' notice or salary in lieu thereof. The services of residents may be terminated without a notice period if bonded candidates from DGME join the institute. The appointment is whole time, and private practice of every kind is prohibited. The appointee will work in shifts, can be posted at any place in the institute, and will be required to stay in campus accommodation if it is provided. Leave is governed by the institute's leave rules as amended from time to time. A certificate of medical fitness from a Medical Board designated by the institute is mandatory before joining.

faq.question: Q1. What is the reporting time and venue for the KSSSCI Medical Physics Resident walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must report at 09:30 AM at the Admin. Block at KSSSCI, Lucknow, and the interview starts at 11:00 AM. Candidates reporting after 11:00 AM will not be allowed to appear.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there for Medical Physics Resident at KSSSCI?
faq.answer: KSSSCI has advertised 01 post of Medical Physics Resident. The notice says the positions are indicative and can increase or decrease at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the KSSSCI Medical Physics Resident post?
faq.answer: The notice requires M.Sc. in Medical Physics/M.Sc. in Physics from a recognized University followed by postgraduate Diploma in Radiological Physics from BARC, Mumbai or equivalent qualification recommended to AERB, Mumbai. It also states that the candidate should be registered with Medical Council / Dental Council of U.P.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the KSSSCI Medical Physics Resident post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years as on the date of interview. SC/ST/OBC, Government servants and other categories get relaxation as per UP Government rules/DoPT rules, but only candidates with Uttar Pradesh domicile get this benefit.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a KSSSCI Medical Physics Resident?
faq.answer: The initial pay is Rs. 35,400 in the pay matrix Rs. 35,400-1,12,400/- Level-6. Pay and allowances are as per the 7th Pay Commission, as per State Government / institute rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee and how is it paid?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 500 and it is non-refundable. It is paid by RTGS/NEFT to SBI Account No. 37868945001 ('Director, SSCI&H, Academic Account', IFSC SBIN0007789), and the receipt is enclosed with the application form.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should be brought to the KSSSCI walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should bring the filled application form with annexures, the fee payment receipt, self-attested photocopies and originals of all relevant certificates and testimonials, and three recent passport size photographs. Employed candidates must also bring a No Objection Certificate.

faq.question: Q8. Is the KSSSCI Medical Physics Resident post permanent?
faq.answer: The appointment is contractual for a tenure of 12 months and expires automatically on completion. It gives no right to regular appointment or permanent absorption, and renewal is at the absolute discretion of Director, KSSSCI.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the KSSSCI Medical Physics Resident result be declared?
faq.answer: The results will be declared on the institute website, and the appointment letter will be sent to selected candidates by e-mail.

faq.question: Q10. Will travelling allowance be paid for joining the KSSSCI Medical Physics Resident post?
faq.answer: The notice states that no travelling or other allowances will be paid to the candidate for joining the post.
